test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

Six persons Anshul, Manohar, Pardhu, Vikram, Vasu and Prerna are standing in a circle, facing the centre. Prerna is to the immediate right of Vikram. Manohar is an immediate neighbour of both Vikram and Pardhu. Anshul is an immediate neighbour of both Vasu and Pardhu.

Who stands to the immediate left of Anshul?
solution:
Given: Anshul, Manohar, Pardhu, Vikram, Vasu and Prerna are standing in a circle, facing the centre.

1. Prerna is to the immediate right of Vikram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0f689a46ad7db7f22c6dd64bbd5bdefeba9c363c750fea3dad5c64fb9aa23ca.png] 

2: Manohar is an immediate neighbour of both Vikram and Pardhu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e294910e7c105b4a846336a9e0edc91bd4b43d9249bfb0b62535798f9794fce5.png] 

3: Anshul is an immediate neighbour of both Vasu and Pardhu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef62637f73f2bbdf56c192178128e7364f1edfe94fb4e2cee27b590b02f79a66.png] 

From the figure it can be clearly seen that immediate left of Anshul is Vashu. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Vashu"**.
